head: 775feb8a4e080af69d5eee1c6c4c8f3d363bfd24

openspec_archive.stdout: desktop-workbench MODIFIED failed for header "### Requirement: Present academic workbench information" - not found; Aborted. No files were changed.

root_cause: The UI redesign delta referenced an obsolete requirement header while the current desktop-workbench base specification uses Present document workbench information. OpenSpec returned exit zero despite aborting without changes.
resolution: Align the MODIFIED requirement header with the current base specification and reject any OpenSpec archive result whose stdout reports Aborted even when the process exits zero.
